parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the cooling of water.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Use the thermometer to measure room temperature θ R . θ R = ...........................................................[1]

ms.label: 2(a)
ms.text: Sensible value for room temperature with unit °C

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) • Pour 200 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. Place the thermometer in the beaker. • Measure the temperature θ of the hot water in the beaker. Record this temperature in Table 2.1 at time t = 0 s. • Immediately start the stopclock. • After 180 s, measure the temperature θ shown on the thermometer. Record the time and temperature in the table. • After a total of 360 s, measure the temperature θ shown on the thermometer. Record the time and temperature in the table. Table 2.1 t / s θ / °C 0 [4]
